FROM ai_code_rule WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = '0' AND status = 1
AND ( scene = #{scene} OR scene = 'COMMON'

)
AND (source_object_code IS NULL OR source_object_code = '' OR source_object_code = #{sourceObjectCode})
AND (source_object_code IS NULL OR source_object_code = '')
AND in_code_list = 1
ORDER BY builtin DESC, rule_code ASC
